name: Misanagi Sayo
source:
The protagonist’s new master.
Despite the way she acts, she is amazingly brilliant and charismatic.
She stopped growing and her baby face tends to make her look younger. Although she doesn't say it out loud, she seems bothered by it.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/VJ015336.html]DLsite[/url]]
